elements.texte:
[cheerful] The warehouse dashboard shows three counters, still empty.

They must show the number of products, of categories and of products to reorder.

Everything starts from the products table, which holds one row per product.

These totals aren’t stored in the table: you have to calculate them by counting the relevant data.

elements.texte:
[cheerful] Count star counts all the rows of the products table.

Each row matches one product: so we get the total number of products.

Result: a single row, with the number 8.

Careful: count of column only counts the values that are filled in.

In the customers table, count of email gives 8: the null emails are ignored.

Count star, on the other hand, gives 10: it counts every row, null included.
